summary:
[Goal] "In the reports folder: any file whose text contains the word DRAFT is obsolete - delete it. Every other report is final: give it the same name with "-final" inserted before the ".md" (copy the content over to the new name, then delete the original). Do not change any content."
[Done] Deleted `reports/alpha.md` and `reports/gamma.md` because their content contained "DRAFT". Renamed `reports/beta.md` to `reports/beta-final.md` by copying its content unchanged and deleting the original.
[State] The reports folder now contains only `reports/beta-final.md`.
[Key values] reports/beta-final.md
[Decisions] Treated "DRAFT" as a case-sensitive literal substring match for obsolescence.
[User] User works with a reports folder and expects strict, content-preserving file operations.
